Keep session notes: after each request,: Keep session notes: after each request, have the AI bring CLAUDE.md (and README.md) in the session's folder up to date
So there's always a record to pick the w: So there's always a record to pick the work up from if a session ends. When a request is done, the tab sends the message below, and the AI writes down what was asked, what it did, where things stand and what's next, and adds your request, word for word, to REQUESTS.md. In the conversation it's one line (click it for what it did), above the reply. Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md when it starts, and the other providers are told to. It's an extra (short) turn each time, so it uses a little more of your plan. Not in your user folder or a drive's root, where every project under it would read the notes.
Use the AI sessions on one PC from anoth: Use the AI sessions on one PC from another: open a session running there (what it does shows on both PCs, and either can write to it, answer its questions or stop it), or start a new one there. Switch it on on both: one PC lets others connect (the server), the other connects to it (the client), with the same passphrase on both. A client can have several PCs in its list, and a server can have several PCs connected. Everything sent between them is encrypted with the passphrase.
